summary.text: Sam Meas is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts State Senate, 1st Middlesex District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business consultant.

paragraphs.text: Meas ran in the 2012 Republican primary for the First Essex District Senate seat and lost to Shaun Toohey, 66.9 percent to 33.1 percent.
Ballotpedia also lists him as a candidate in the September 4, 2018 Democratic primary for the 18th Middlesex District of the Massachusetts House of Representatives, which Rady Mom won.
In the March 3, 2026 special general election for the 1st Middlesex District Senate seat, he was the Republican candidate and lost to Democrat Vanna Howard.
